cases.title: Two views of failed Skype TLS
cases.author: Eddi
cases.symptom: Firewall permit log yet Skype TLS exchange fails.
cases.source_finding_and_observations: Eddi describes TCP termination at firewall inferred from sequence/TTL differences, opposing FINs and short server-side interval. A later firewall drop log and configuration change supported that diagnosis. Capture is heavily redacted, including hex edits; successful reverse flow is a control. Independent TShark confirms client handshake frames 47–49, ClientHello 50 and FIN 53; server handshake frames 24–26, ClientHello 27, ServerHello 28 and FIN 29. Neither capture alone proves who sent FIN or why.
cases.alternatives_and_falsifiers: Missing packets, proxy termination, offload or time skew; compare both views, independent firewall logs and a matched successful flow.
cases.current_skill_coverage: Partial: TCP/TLS metadata and FIN counts; no paired-vantage correlation, TLS policy or firewall logs.
cases.adoption_decision: Downloadable pair is small and redacted; strong reference for a paired-vantage workflow, not a primary operational accuracy benchmark.

cases.title: SMB2 slow reads and writes
cases.author: Eddi

cases.current_skill_coverage: Partial TCP indicators; no SMB service-time, credit analysis or multi-vantage correlation.
cases.adoption_decision: High-value operator reference; seek original full captures and rights before any adoption.

cases.title: IKE failures and recovery in controlled lab
cases.author: Johannes Weber
cases.symptom: Four VPN connections fail before deliberate firewall configuration correction.
cases.source_finding_and_observations: Weber describes intentionally wrong phase-one proposals, peer ID, proxy ID and pre-shared key. His source identifies failed traffic around frames 63–250 and corrected exchanges around 475–570 followed by ESP; comment confirms two silent-drop causes cannot be distinguished from trace alone. Independent aggregate sees 226 IKE and 542 ESP frames.
cases.alternatives_and_falsifiers: Same absence of replies can result from loss, policy or capture placement; separate configuration and logs are needed to distinguish silent-drop causes.
cases.current_skill_coverage: Missing IKE interpretation and comparison of failing versus recovered episodes; generic protocol counts only.
cases.adoption_decision: Complete bounded controlled capture, valuable exploratory regression but not production proof or a TCP fault benchmark.

cases.title: Coop logistics Java application stalls
cases.author: Allegro Packets; individual author not stated

cases.source_finding_and_observations: Allegro reports application-layer pauses, no TCP retransmission indicators and short TCP responses; it sent captured protocol streams to the application supplier. The vendor reports the supplier attributed resets to jumbo-frame handling in the Java Socket Selector library and that an update resolved the issue. The capture and supplier records are unavailable, so the causal chain is not independently verified.
cases.alternatives_and_falsifiers: A lack of TCP retransmission indicators alone does not eliminate network, host or capture problems; compare application logs, both endpoint traces, traffic size and a matched service operation after the change.

cases.adoption_decision: Strong incident narrative for future acquisition; obtain original capture and supplier and recovery records before causal validation.

cases.title: Slow login with absent service and misleading DNS
cases.author: Laura Chappell
cases.provenance_grade: documented onsite company incident; screenshots, no public capture established
cases.capture_status: not downloaded / no accessible standalone capture established
cases.symptom: Slow logins and application launches affected an IPX and NetWare network.
cases.source_finding_and_observations: Chappell reports WINS lookup sequences adding 46 seconds to login and unanswered UDP port 34716 transmissions around six seconds apart at source-reported frames 354–356. She associates the latter with a retired Sitemeter service and DNS entries pointing at a non-serving address; onsite staff removed those entries and she reports quicker resolution. Her detailed service sequence includes explicitly labeled inferences.
cases.alternatives_and_falsifiers: Test whether the intended service is running, compare DNS answers and application logs, and reproduce the same login with before/after evidence. Missing captures and undocumented dependencies limit independent attribution.
cases.current_skill_coverage: Partial DNS/UDP frame counts; no legacy IPX/SAP or end-to-end application dependency and startup-delay analysis.
cases.adoption_decision: Historical 2002 operator case and reference only; do not generalize its legacy NetWare/WINS configuration or disable WINS without establishing present dependencies.
